references.text: Gold and silver from the war were brought to the Lord's treasury as a gift to the Lord
Everything devoted to destruction in Israel belongs to the priests and the Lord
Everything devoted to the Lord with a ban is most holy and belongs to the Lord
The silver, gold, and vessels of bronze and iron were placed in the treasury of the house of the Lord
Solomon brought in the things his father David had dedicated to the Lord's treasury
The holy offerings were brought into God's house
Achan took some of the devoted thing, showing the importance that everything should belong to the Lord
The silver and gold belong to the Lord, the God of hosts
